snippet.title: Ferocious - Console Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Out now on Xbox Series X and PlayStation 5!

FEROCIOUS is an immersive survival FPS adventure. Stranded on a dangerous island, face mercenaries, dinosaurs, and a vibrant yet hostile ecosystem. Explore breathtaking environments and survive the onslaught of intense, fast-paced encounters.

Made in Unity by a passionate indie team, FEROCIOUS allows you to test yourself in relentless combat, craft weapons and gear using resources from the environment, and even form a coalition with the ancient creatures.
_________
